args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback action.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — the rollback was to a previously healthy production release.
